name: 18856-batchdecode-ernie45vl28b-1gpu
model: baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT, bf16, unquantized. Public and ungated; ~56 GB over 12 safetensors shards.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one card of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration, ~28B total / ~3B active, bf16, 28 layers, context 131072. A vision tower is part of the checkpoint and loads whether or not a request carries an image. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 160 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Four streams is the declared operating point, not a starting guess for a search.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, TEXT ONLY on this multimodal checkpoint. Prompt 2048 tokens and output 512 tokens both FIXED (stdev 0, min == max), pinned with max_tokens 512, ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A multimodal 28B assistant handling text-only long-form drafting, four concurrent users, 2048-token prompts and 512-token replies, one GPU.
launch:
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested or re-flowed block
# is DROPPED silently and the engine then starts without it at rc=0.

model-path: baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT

# Required by the checkpoint, not a choice: its config and processor are loaded through
# `auto_map` python files the repository ships, and cannot be loaded without executing them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit heuristic, which derives its value per process from
# what is free and so can hand a rerun a different pool. ~57 GB of bf16 weights on an 80 GB card
# leaves no headroom above this: if the engine will not start, trim it; do not raise it.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 0
